title: Lease manager with expiry
description: Time-limited leases on worktree, branch and stream with owner id, expiry and fencing token.
acceptance: Second claimant is refused while a lease is valid
Expired lease can be taken and the old fencing token is rejected
Lease operations are atomic under concurrent processes
core_adaptation: Heartbeat and expiry sweep live here; there is no separate heartbeat row in Core.
